title: ClaimOptions
description: What a worker's claiming of jobs is told: the jobs it takes, and how long it waits for what it waits on. A wait left out is client/timing.json's of the same name.

jobClaimTimeoutMs.description: How long it waits for the answer to one claim, in milliseconds.

heldJobStallMs.description: How long a held job may show no activity before it is called stalled, in milliseconds.

heldJobStallCheckMs.description: How often it looks at how long a held job has shown no activity, in milliseconds.

markCommitTimeoutMs.description: How long it waits for the record to acknowledge a commit of annotations, in milliseconds.
